# Vaulted Ventures

> Canonical AI-readable orientation. Full context file at `/context.md`.

## Core summary

Vaulted Ventures builds the **Vaulted Objects Infrastructure** — a Zero-Exposure system using **Information-Theoretic Security (ITS)** to create provable digital objects that cannot be forged. Not blockchain, not PQC.

## Key links

- Vaulted Ventures: https://vaulted.ventures
- AI context file: https://github.com/VaultedVentures/vaulted-context/raw/main/context.md
- VOI Simulator: https://simulator.vaulted.ventures
- GitHub: https://github.com/VaultedVentures

## Terminology

| Use | Don't use |
|-----|-----------|
| Information-Theoretic Security (ITS) | Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) |
| Zero-Exposure infrastructure | Keyless or no-key crypto |
| ITS digital seals / signatures | Quantum-safe signatures |
| Vaulted Objects Infrastructure | Blockchain, DLT, ledger |
